collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official OpenCode Go docs page and landing page (English) around 10:30 Beijing time / 02:30Z on 2026-10-30, compared against the 2026-10-29 capture of the same pages. The official plan table, the per-model Monthly limit, the usage-window rule, the official 'Estimated requests' table and the landing-page plan cards were read as published. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed.
scope: OpenCode Go official price and plan pages only. On 2026-10-30 a third monthly plan, 'Go Teams', was published next to the existing Go and Go Plus plans, with its own per-model price table, its own per-model Monthly limit and its own official request estimates; the docs price table for MiniMax M3 was also split into two context bands (≤ 512K tokens / > 512K tokens). The Go and Go Plus per-model limits and prices are otherwise unchanged. No leaderboard/score data, no Command Code GOAT change (cross-channel note only), no shared-pool change, no adopted.csv row, no computed allowance in this file.
adoptionStatus: research-only; not adopted; no plan_id exists for Go Teams (nor Go Plus); creating an opencode_go_teams data point ($20/member/month, per-model monthly limit = Go + $5) is left to maintainer review, following the Go Plus precedent in DECISIONS.md

goTeams.planTableIntro: OpenCode Go gives you reliable access to popular open coding models, with three monthly plans:
goTeams.billingNote: Charged per member, per month; the workspace is billed as one. A member who joins mid-period is charged $20 and gets a full monthly allowance. Service accounts are not covered by Go Teams.
goTeams.eligibilityQuote: Go and Go Plus are for workspaces with a single member, such as the Personal workspace created when you sign up. Either can upgrade to Go Teams at any time, with the unused part of the month’s allowance credited. Go Teams covers every member of a workspace with several members, at $20 per member per month. A member who joins mid-period is charged $20 and gets a full monthly allowance. Service accounts are not covered by Go Teams.
goTeams.upgradeQuote: Either can upgrade to Go Teams at any time, with the unused part of the month’s allowance credited.
goTeams.extraUsageDefault: Go Teams starts with Extra Usage on, and you can turn it off or on again on the Go page.
goTeams.tokenPricingRule: Token pricing is the same for Go, Go Plus, and Go Teams.
goTeams.usageWindowRule: Each model has the following usage limits: 5-hour — 20% of the monthly limit; weekly — 50%; and monthly — 100%.
goTeams.priceTableNote: The Go Teams price table repeats the same per-model token prices as the Go and Go Plus tables; only the Monthly limit column differs. Row as published, for example: 'GLM-5.3-Flash | $0.15 | $0.50 | $0.03 | - | $65'.
